# Crime Scene

> > Interactive fictional murder investigations where players examine evidence, interview witnesses, and solve cases since 1995.

Crime Scene is a long-running interactive mystery platform set in Yoknapatawpha County that combines detective gameplay with community investigation. Players can solve the current active case, explore archived solved cases, and interact with detectives and fellow websleuths through forums and Q&A features.

## Key Topics

- Interactive murder mystery
- Case investigation
- Evidence examination
- Witness interviews
- Detective game
- Crime solving
- Yoknapatawpha County
- Case files
- Community investigation
- Solved cases
- Detective interaction
- Crime scene analysis
- Interactive case documents
- Websleuth community

## Current Investigation

- [Crime Scene Homepage](https://www.crimescene.com): Interactive fictional murder cases since 1995.
- [The Current Case](https://www.crimescene.com/the-case-2): Current Crime Scene investigation with evidence reports and transcripts.
- [Case Files](https://www.crimescene.com/the-case-2/case-file-list): Complete case files with police reports, interviews, and evidence.
- [Latest Info](https://www.crimescene.com/the-case-2/latestinfo): Latest evidence updates on current Crime Scene investigation.
- [Case Recap](https://www.crimescene.com/the-case-2/recap): Case summary and timeline for current Crime Scene investigation.
- [Detective Files](https://www.crimescene.com/the-case-2/case-detectivefiles): Exclusive detective files and advance info for paid subscribers.

- [Raw Deal](https://www.crimescene.com/previous/the-raw-deal-case): Solved case with Fontaine family murder investigation.
- [Deck the Elf](https://www.crimescene.com/previous/deck-the-elf-case): Solved case investigating Caroline Jordan murder.

- [Helping Hand](https://www.crimescene.com/previous/helpinghand-case): Solved case investigating severed hand discovery.
- [Drop Dead Gorgeous](https://www.crimescene.com/previous/drop-dead-gorgeous-case): Solved case from beauty pageant investigation.
- [Perfect Aim](https://www.crimescene.com/previous/perfect-aim-case): Solved case investigating Frederick Miller murder.
- [Karma Kills](https://www.crimescene.com/previous/kama-kills-case): Solved case investigating Victor Jennings murder.
- [Killer Headache](https://www.crimescene.com/previous/killer-headache): Solved case investigating Diane Coates death.
- [The Last Word](https://www.crimescene.com/previous/the-last-word): Solved case investigating Zoe Chase murder.

## Community & Support

- [Forums](https://www.crimescene.com/theforums): Community forum for websleuths to discuss theories and cases.
- [Ask the Detective](https://www.crimescene.com/atd-askquestions): Q&A forum where paid subscribers interact with case detectives.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.crimescene.com/faqs): FAQ explaining how Crime Scene interactive murder investigations work.
